title: Request
description: pcs.v2 machine request envelope (J.4). Model self-declared authorization fields (for example role/approved_by) are not representable: unknown top-level fields are rejected.

operation.description: Operation name such as record.get or proposal.submit. The set is open here; an unsupported operation is the runtime error UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION, not a structural error.

expected_state_revision.description: Read-only request basis; null for reads (J.4).

payload.description: Operation-specific payload. proposal.submit requires context_id, run_id, kind and body (J.4); that inner shape belongs to the command layer, not to this envelope.
